mapper.select: SELECT s.student_id, s.student_name, si.level_no, si.exp, si.books_read, lv.level_name, lv.title, lv.feature, lv.required_exp, ch.image_url AS character_img FROM erp_student s JOIN erp_bookstore_student_info si ON si.student_id = s.student_id JOIN erp_bookstore_level lv ON lv.level_no = si.level_no LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_character ch ON ch.character_id = si.character_id WHERE s.student_id = #{studentId}
SELECT level_no, required_exp FROM erp_bookstore_level ORDER BY level_no ASC

SELECT b.badge_name, b.description, b.image_url, sb.acquired_at FROM erp_bookstore_student_badge sb JOIN erp_bookstore_badge b ON b.badge_id = sb.badge_id WHERE sb.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY sb.acquired_at DESC

SELECT r.content_id, bc.original_title, bc.image_url, r.status FROM erp_bookstore_reading r JOIN erp_bookstore_content bc ON bc.content_id = r.content_id WHERE r.student_id = #{studentId} AND ( r.status = 'READING' OR (r.status = 'DONE' AND r.completed_at >= DATEADD(day, 1 - DAY(GETDATE()), CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE))) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN r.status = 'READING' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, r.completed_at DESC

SELECT TOP 1 bc.content_id, bc.original_title, bc.author, bc.publisher, bc.summary, bc.keywords, bc.image_url, ct.codeNm AS content_type_name, g.codeNm AS genre_name, dc.name AS curriculum_name, dr.name AS recommend_org_name, da.name AS award_name FROM erp_bookstore_recommend_log rl JOIN erp_bookstore_content bc ON bc.content_id = rl.content_id LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code ct ON ct.gubun = 'C' AND ct.code = bc.content_type LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code g ON g.gubun = 'G' AND g.code = bc.genre LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail dc ON dc.content_id = bc.content_id AND dc.gubun = 'C' LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail dr ON dr.content_id = bc.content_id AND dr.gubun = 'R' LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail da ON da.content_id = bc.content_id AND da.gubun = 'A' WHERE rl.student_id = #{studentId} AND CAST(rl.recommended_at AS DATE) = CAST(GETDATE() AS DATE) ORDER BY rl.recommend_id DESC

SELECT p.content_id, bc.content_type, bc.genre, p.sort_order FROM erp_bookstore_priority_draft d JOIN erp_bookstore_priority p ON p.draft_id = d.draft_id JOIN erp_bookstore_content bc ON bc.content_id = p.content_id WHERE d.year = #{year} AND d.schoolyear = #{schoolyear} AND d.is_active = 'Y' AND bc.state = 'Y' ORDER BY p.sort_order ASC

SELECT TOP 1 bc.content_type, bc.genre FROM erp_bookstore_reading r JOIN erp_bookstore_content bc ON bc.content_id = r.content_id WHERE r.student_id = #{studentId} AND r.status = 'DONE' ORDER BY r.completed_at DESC

SELECT bc.content_id, bc.original_title, bc.author, bc.publisher, bc.summary, bc.keywords, bc.image_url, ct.codeNm AS content_type_name, g.codeNm AS genre_name, dc.name AS curriculum_name, dr.name AS recommend_org_name, da.name AS award_name FROM erp_bookstore_content bc LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code ct ON ct.gubun = 'C' AND ct.code = bc.content_type LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_code g ON g.gubun = 'G' AND g.code = bc.genre LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail dc ON dc.content_id = bc.content_id AND dc.gubun = 'C' LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail dr ON dr.content_id = bc.content_id AND dr.gubun = 'R' LEFT JOIN erp_bookstore_content_detail da ON da.content_id = bc.content_id AND da.gubun = 'A' WHERE bc.content_id = #{contentId}
